title: Can’t see newly imported PNG in enemy image list ( RPG Maker MZ)

posts.author: jiujianxian
posts.body:
Hi, everyone
I'm currently using RPG Maker MZ and I'm having trouble with imported enemy images not appearing in the database.
I imported a PNG file named glorrify_1.png (500x500) into the img/enemies/ folder using the built-in Resource Manager. The import completed successfully, and the file is visible in the folder. However, when I try to assign it in the enemy image selector (Database > Enemies), the image does not appear in the list.
Here is what I’ve tried:
Verified the file is a valid .png and opens normally
File name uses only lowercase letters and underscores (no spaces or special characters)
Re-imported the file multiple times
Restarted RPG Maker MZ and the project
Removed all .jpg and .jpeg files that were mistakenly imported earlier
Tried using different filenames and different images
Tried manually typing the image name in the selector
Despite all of this, the new image still does not show up in the list.
Another strange thing: even when I delete existing images from the img/enemies/ folder, they still appear in the image selector. And no new images appear even after a successful import. It seems like the image list is cached or not updating properly.
Oddly, a few days ago I accidentally managed to import some custom images successfully, and they still appear in the list. But I have no idea what was different that time.
Is there any way to force the database or image selector to refresh? Or is there a cache or file that needs to be manually cleared or updated?
Any help would be greatly appreciated.
Thanks in advance.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Is your battle sideview? Did you put it in sv_enemies folder?

posts.author: Trihan
posts.body: It probably needs to be in sv_enemies, as rpgLord69 said.
